_about: The developer menu (scripts/camp/dev_menu.gd, scripts/camp/dev_tools.gd): F1 or the DualSense's Create button in a camp, only in a debug build (the editor) or with -- --dev on the command line; anywhere else F1 shows just the fps line. rows is the menu, top to bottom: kind 'pick' cycles values left and right (live: true applies each step at once, otherwise interact applies the picked value), 'do' runs on interact, 'toggle' flips on interact or left and right; host: true rows are asked of the host, who decides (online the host's build must have dev tools too), the rest change only this PC. Row names are in data/text.json dev.row.<id>. speeds are the clock speeds the host can run. coins_step coins and give_n of an item per press. guest_spots ([x, z] metres, camp space) are tried in turn for a free tent pitch when a guest is called with none free; places are teleport spots (names in dev.place.<id>); previews are models shown beside the player to look at (one missing from data/models.json, such as a model still being made, is left out of the list). preview_ahead_m is how far in front of the player a preview stands. story jumps the arrival evening (data/ranger.json) to a step: the cold fire, naming the camp or the clipboard handover, and Ranger Burl says that step's lines again; letter shows his letter. stick_deadzone is how far the stick must lean to step once. panel sizes are in pixels.
